correctness.rationale: Directed Euler-trail equivalence proves an exact nonnegative-flow parametrization. Finite support plus 13 imbalance cases are exhaustively reduced to geometric sums, evaluated by an integer polynomial identity. Independent direct word enumeration n=3..14 and integer-flow enumeration n=3..87 agree, but the exact rational certificate, not these finite experiments, is the infinite proof. The zero-contributing 22 formal supports are correctly canceled.
